sentences.text: Order Sheet 10/01/2025 Mr. Vaibhav Shukla, Advocate for the petitioner.
Heard on I.A. No. 1 which is an application for grant of interim relief/ stay.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the claim case was filed by claimants for grant of compensation and it was filed beyond period of six months along with an application for condonation of delay under Section 5 of Limitation Act which was allowed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Surajpur
He argues that there is no provision for condonation of delay particularly in Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, therefore, the learned tribunal committed an error of law in allowing such application.

Taking into consideration the submission made hereinabove, purely as an interim measure, there shall be a stay on further proceeding of the claim case pending before learned tribunal till the next date of hearing.
Issue notice to respondents on payment of PF by ordinary as well as registered mode.
